preconditions.description: The length of list s1 must be between 1 and 5000.
The length of list s2 must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(s) < 25 for s in s1)
preconditions.description: Each string in s1 must have a length between 5 and 24.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(s) < 25 for s in s2)
preconditions.description: Each string in s2 must have a length between 5 and 24.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for s in s2 if any(s in s1_str for s1_str in s1) or any(s1_str.endswith(s) for s1_str in s1))
postconditions.description: The return value must be the count of strings in s2 that are either a prefix or suffix of at least one string in s1.
